crossRefs.note: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?
Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”

parallels.note: Moses said, “Oh, Lord, please send someone else.”

people.name: Manoah
people.line: Father of Samson, from the tribe of Dan.

translations.web: Then Manoah entreated Yahweh, and said, “Oh, Lord, please let the man of God whom you sent come again to us, and teach us what we should do to the child who shall be born.”
translations.bsb: Then Manoah prayed to the LORD, “Please, O Lord, let the man of God You sent us come to us again to teach us how to raise the boy who is to be born.”
translations.kjv: Then Manoah intreated the LORD, and said, O my Lord, let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.
translations.asv: Then Manoah entreated Jehovah, and said, Oh, Lord, I pray thee, let the man of God whom thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.
